title: How Does a Plant Cell Split? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
Aarav twisted a long balloon in the middle and it became two balloons, but you cannot twist a cardboard box in two. An animal cell is soft, but a plant cell has a stiff wall. So how does a plant cell split in two?

You will see what cytokinesis is, a zoom ladder into the middle of a plant cell where the cell plate becomes the middle lamella, and both ways running live: a furrow pinching an animal cell from the outside in, and a cell plate growing from the centre out in a plant cell. Then four reasons mitosis matters (growth, the nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio, repair, meristems), animal vs plant side by side, a pause and think, six cells sorted, the syncytium exam trap (liquid endosperm of coconut), an original assertion and reason question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions. This is Episode 77 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.
